uploadDescription: Drop images here or choose files. Your images stay on this device.
uploadHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP · Up to 50 images, 20 MB each, 100 MB total
previewDescription: Select an image to preview. The same settings apply to every image.
emptyDescription: Add an image to start. Adjust the watermark and preview it before exporting.
logoHint: Choose a PNG with transparency for a clean logo overlay.
customPositionHint: 0% is left/top and 100% is right/bottom, within the edge margin.
editHint: Drag to move, drag a corner to resize, or drag the round handle to rotate. Arrow keys adjust the focused control; hold Shift for larger steps. Escape cancels a drag.
sizeHint: Width relative to the shorter image side; scales consistently across your batch.
exportHint: Original dimensions are preserved. JPEG uses a white background for transparent areas. Animated images become still images.
exportSuccess: Export ready. Your download has started.
invalidFile: Choose PNG, JPEG, or WebP images, up to 20 MB each, 50 images and 100 MB in total.
imageError: This image could not be read. Try another image up to 24 megapixels and 16,384 pixels per side.
exportError: Export failed. Try fewer or smaller images, or choose another output format.
